An anchor split around a block keeps the half that carries its text

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"/o\">Text<div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
